narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The bigger the angle, the sharper it is, because it is bigger.
<bookmark mark='press'/>Press both tips on paper. The wide tip leaves a flat wide mark, but the narrow tip leaves a tiny dot.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The wider tip is the blunter one, not the sharper one.
